EXLD.description: Prestress Loads (EXLD). Defines the set of static load cases treated as external-type (pretension) load cases; the sole key LCNAME_ITEM lists the names of the static load cases to include.

LCNAME_ITEM.description: Names of the static load cases (STLD) to register as external/pretension load cases. Each entry is resolved to a static load case key; on write, a non-empty list replaces the existing set.
